```artifact
Feature: VTI and VTE Alarm Computations
  As a user of the GUI,
  I want to be alerted when VTI or VTE values exceed specified thresholds,
  So that I can take appropriate actions.

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm is active when VTI exceeds threshold
    Given the LOW VTI alarm threshold is set to 100
    When the VTI for the current breath is 101
    Then the LOW VTI alarm should be active

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm is not active when VTI is below threshold
    Given the LOW VTI alarm threshold is set to 100
    When the VTI for the current breath is 99
    Then the LOW VTI alarm should not be active

  Scenario: LOW VTI alarm is of medium priority
    Given the LOW VTI alarm is active
    Then the LOW VTI alarm priority should be medium

  Scenario Outline: LOW VTI alarm threshold can be set between X and Y
    Given the LOW VTI alarm threshold control is available
    When the threshold is set to <value>
    Then the LOW VTI alarm threshold should be <value>
    Examples:
      | value |
      | X     |
      | Y     |
      | 50    |  # Normal value
      | X-1   |  # Below lower bound
      | Y+1   |  # Above upper bound

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm is active when VTI exceeds threshold
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm threshold is set to 200
    When the VTI for the current breath is 201
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm should be active

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm is not active when VTI is below threshold
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm threshold is set to 200
    When the VTI for the current breath is 199
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm should not be active

  Scenario: HIGH VTI alarm is of medium priority
    Given the HIGH VTI alarm is active
    Then the HIGH VTI alarm priority should be medium

  Scenario: VTI is computed for each breath
    Given the system is monitoring breaths
    When a breath is detected
    Then the VTI for the breath should be computed

  Scenario: LOW VTE alarm is active when VTE exceeds threshold
    Given the LOW VTE alarm threshold is set to 50
    When the VTE for the current breath is 51
    Then the LOW VTE alarm should be active
```
